name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy cookies with crisp edges and chocolate chunks.
instructions: Cream butter and sugars.
Mix in dry ingredients and chocolate.
Bake at 350 F until golden.

name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
description: Soft spiced oatmeal cookies with raisins.
instructions: Combine oats and dry ingredients.
Stir in butter, egg, and raisins.
Bake at 350 F for 12 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Tender peanut butter cookies with a classic fork pattern.
instructions: Mix ingredients into a dough.
Shape and press with a fork.
Bake at 350 F until set.

name: Lemon Shortbread Cookies
description: Buttery shortbread brightened with lemon zest.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar with lemon zest.
Mix in flour and chill briefly.
Slice and bake at 325 F.

name: Vegan Double Chocolate Cookies
description: Rich cocoa cookies made without dairy or eggs.
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients.
Stir in oil, plant milk, and chocolate.
Bake at 350 F for 12 minutes.

name: Gluten-Free Almond Cookies
description: Chewy almond cookies with a delicate crisp crust.
instructions: Fold ingredients into a sticky dough.
Shape into small rounds.
Bake at 325 F until lightly browned.

name: Fudgy Brownies
description: Dense chocolate brownies with a shiny crackled top.
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter.
Whisk in sugar and eggs, then fold in flour.
Bake at 350 F and cool before slicing.

name: Walnut Brownies
description: Classic cocoa brownies with toasted walnuts.
instructions: Whisk melted butter with cocoa and sugar.
Add eggs, flour, and walnuts.
Bake at 350 F until the center is just set.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Brownies
description: Moist cocoa brownies naturally sweetened with sweet potato.
instructions: Whisk puree with maple syrup.
Fold in cocoa and oat flour.
Bake at 350 F until firm at the edges.

name: Gluten-Free Tahini Brownies
description: Fudgy sesame brownies made with almond flour.
instructions: Whisk tahini with eggs and sugar.
Stir in cocoa and almond flour.
Bake at 350 F and cool fully.

name: No-Knead Country Bread
description: Crusty artisan loaf with a chewy open crumb.
instructions: Mix ingredients into a shaggy dough.
Rest covered overnight.
Bake in a hot covered pot until deeply browned.

name: Whole Wheat Sandwich Bread
description: Soft everyday loaf with a mild nutty flavor.
instructions: Knead ingredients until smooth.
Let rise until doubled and shape into a loaf.
Bake at 375 F until hollow sounding.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist quick bread made with ripe bananas.
instructions: Mash bananas and mix with wet ingredients.
Fold in flour just until combined.
Bake at 350 F until a tester comes out clean.

name: Rosemary Focaccia
description: Olive oil rich bread topped with rosemary and sea salt.
instructions: Mix and proof the dough until airy.
Press into an oiled pan and dimple the surface.
Top with rosemary and bake at 425 F.

name: Gluten-Free Seeded Loaf
description: Hearty gluten-free loaf packed with seeds.
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients and seeds.
Add warm water and rest the dough.
Bake at 375 F until the loaf sounds hollow.

name: Blueberry Muffins
description: Fluffy muffins filled with juicy blueberries.
instructions: Whisk dry and wet ingredients separately.
Combine gently and fold in blueberries.
Bake at 375 F until golden.

name: Apple Cinnamon Muffins
description: Tender muffins with fresh apple and cinnamon.
instructions: Toss diced apple with cinnamon.
Fold into the muffin batter.
Bake at 375 F until a tester comes out clean.

name: Vegan Chocolate Chip Muffins
description: Dairy-free muffins with chocolate chips.
instructions: Whisk plant milk, oil, and sugar.
Fold in dry ingredients and chocolate chips.
Bake at 375 F until risen and golden.

name: Gluten-Free Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
description: Bright lemon muffins with a tender gluten-free crumb.
instructions: Whisk flour and poppy seeds.
Mix with eggs, yogurt, lemon, and sugar.
Bake at 375 F until lightly browned.

name: Vanilla Birthday Cake
description: Soft vanilla layer cake with a simple buttercream.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs and fold in flour with milk.
Bake in two pans at 350 F and frost when cool.

name: Carrot Cake
description: Spiced carrot cake with a moist crumb.
instructions: Whisk oil, sugar, and eggs.
Fold in carrots, flour, spices, and walnuts.
Bake at 350 F until the center springs back.

name: Vegan Chocolate Cake
description: Deep chocolate cake made without dairy or eggs.
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients.
Stir in water, oil, and vinegar.
Bake at 350 F until a tester comes out clean.

name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
description: Rich, naturally gluten-free chocolate dessert cake.
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk in eggs and sugar.
Bake in a lined pan at 350 F and chill before serving.

name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
description: Light loaf cake finished with a tart lemon glaze.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs.
Fold in flour and lemon zest.
Bake at 350 F and drizzle with lemon syrup.

name: Vegan Coconut Cake
description: Tender coconut cake with plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Whisk coconut milk with oil, sugar, and vanilla.
Fold in flour and shredded coconut.
Bake at 350 F until golden and springy.

name: French Macarons
description: Delicate almond meringue cookies with smooth shells and a crisp-chewy center.
instructions: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar together.
Whip egg whites with granulated sugar to stiff glossy peaks and fold in the dry mixture.
Pipe rounds onto lined trays, rest until dry to the touch, then bake at 300 F for 14 to 16 minutes.
Cool completely and sandwich with buttercream.

name: Classic Baked Cheesecake
description: Creamy vanilla cheesecake on a buttery graham cracker crust.
instructions: Press crumbs mixed with melted butter into a springform pan and prebake at 350 F for 8 minutes.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then mix in eggs one at a time and add vanilla.
Pour over the crust and bake in a water bath at 325 F until the center is just set.
Cool gradually and chill for at least 4 hours before slicing.

name: Soft Cinnamon Rolls
description: Pillowy yeast rolls filled with cinnamon sugar and finished with vanilla glaze.
instructions: Bloom yeast in warm milk with a spoonful of sugar.
Mix with flour, egg, and softened butter and knead until smooth; let rise until doubled.
Roll dough out, spread with butter, and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll, slice, proof until puffy, and bake at 350 F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Drizzle with a simple vanilla glaze while warm.

name: Buttermilk Scones
description: Tender, flaky breakfast scones with lightly crisp tops.
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in cold butter until the mixture has pea-sized pieces.
Stir in buttermilk just until a soft dough forms and shape into a round.
Cut into wedges, brush with milk, and bake at 400 F for 16 to 18 minutes.

name: Classic Sugar Cookies
description: Buttery sugar cookies that hold their shape and decorate beautifully.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in egg and vanilla, then mix in flour and a pinch of salt.
Chill dough for 30 minutes, roll out, and cut into shapes.
Bake at 350 F for 8 to 10 minutes and cool before decorating.

name: Classic Apple Pie
description: Flaky double crust filled with cinnamon-spiced apples.
instructions: Heat oven to 425 F and line a pie plate with one dough disc.
Toss sliced apples with sugar, flour, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Fill the crust, dot with butter, cover with the second crust, and seal the edges.
Vent the top and bake 20 minutes, then reduce heat to 375 F and bake 35 minutes until bubbling.
Cool for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Vanilla Cupcakes
description: Light vanilla cupcakes topped with a simple buttercream frosting.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla, then alternate mixing in flour and milk.
Divide batter among 12 lined muffin cups.
Bake at 350 F for 18 to 20 minutes and cool completely before frosting.

name: Butter Croissants
description: Laminated French pastries with crisp golden layers and a tender center.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and milk into a smooth dough and chill.
Enclose a cold butter block in the dough and roll and fold it in three turns, chilling between turns.
Roll out, cut into triangles, and shape into crescents.
Proof until light and puffy, brush with egg wash, and bake at 400 F for about 20 minutes.

name: Banana Muffins
description: Moist, tender muffins made with ripe bananas and a hint of cinnamon.
instructions: Mash the bananas and stir in melted butter, sugar, and eggs.
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt in a separate bowl.
Fold dry ingredients into the banana mixture just until combined.
Divide into a lined muffin pan and bake at 350 F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Skillet Cornbread
description: Golden, tender cornbread with crisp buttery edges.
instructions: Heat oven to 400 F and warm a greased cast-iron skillet.
Whisk cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt.
Mix buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and honey, then fold into the dry ingredients.
Pour batter into the hot skillet and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until golden.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Soft breakfast pancakes with crisp edges and a light, airy crumb.
instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Whisk buttermilk, egg, and melted butter, then stir into the dry mixture until just combined.
Rest batter for 5 minutes while a lightly greased griddle heats over medium heat.
Cook pancakes until bubbles form, flip, and cook the second side until golden.

name: Tangy Lemon Bars
description: Bright lemon curd baked over a buttery shortbread crust and dusted with sugar.
instructions: Heat oven to 350 F and line an 8-inch square pan.
Mix flour, softened butter, and powdered sugar; press into the pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Whisk granulated sugar, eggs, lemon juice, and a little flour until smooth.
Pour filling over the warm crust and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until just set.
Cool fully, chill, and dust with powdered sugar before cutting into bars.
